title: Colour wheel
subject: Art & Design
source: Written for art/y8 lesson 17 (Colour wheel (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 17: Pattern and colour planning. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Colour each segment. Analogous colours sit next to each other and blend well; complementary colours sit opposite and can turn muddy when dyes run together.

panels.title: Repeat and symmetry
points: Fold in quarters for four-way symmetry

keywords.def: a pattern that happens again and again
colours next to each other on the colour wheel

questions.q: Plan colours for a radial design with three analogous colours.
questions.a: For example: yellow centre, orange middle, red edge.

questions.q: Complete the plan sheet for your final piece (fold diagram, colour placement, binding) and colour a paper mock-up; upload both.
Extend: plan a second version with a complementary accent and explain the risk.
questions.a: A version with a note on muddy mixing.

questions.q: Which pair is least likely to turn muddy?
questions.a: A) Yellow and orange. Analogous colours blend well.
next to each other on the wheel
options: next to each other on the wheel

questions.q: Think again: Why do some colour mixes look muddy when dyes run together?
questions.a: Opposite colours (like purple and yellow) mix to brown; neighbouring colours blend well.
